seriesTitle: Batman: The Brave and the Bold

episodes.title: The Rise of the Blue Beetle!
episodes.summary: Batman and Blue Beetle go on a mission to destroy an asteroid heading for a space station, only to go up against the deadly Kanjar Ro.

episodes.title: Terror on Dinosaur Island!
episodes.summary: When Gorilla Grodd creates a machine that will turn humans into primates, it's up to Batman and Plastic Man to save the day.

episodes.title: Evil Under the Sea!
episodes.summary: Batman visits Aquaman during an investigation into some unusual seismic activity. There he discovers that Aquaman's brother Orm is working with Black Manta to conquer Atlantis.

episodes.title: Invasion of the Secret Santas!
episodes.summary: After a team-up with Blue Beetle to defeat Sportsmaster, Batman and Red Tornado take on the villainous Fun Haus, who plans to ruin Christmas for everyone.

episodes.title: Day of the Dark Knight!
episodes.summary: The evil Morgaine Le Fey has taken over Camelot and Etrigan and turned everyone to stone! To thwart her plans, Merlin transports Batman and Green Arrow back in time to retrieve Excalibur, battle dragons and return King Arthur to the throne.

episodes.title: Enter the Outsiders!
episodes.summary: Batman teams up with the super-powered animal master B'wana Beast to take on Black Manta. Then he joins forces with Wildcat, his old mentor, to take down three super-powered teenage criminals known as "The Outsiders."

episodes.title: Dawn of the Dead Man!
episodes.summary: Trapped in a coffin, Batman must take astral form in order to stop the Gentleman Ghost from raising an army of the criminal undead.

episodes.title: Fall of the Blue Beetle!
episodes.summary: The Blue Beetle is determined to learn the fate of his predecessor, Ted Kord.

episodes.title: Journey to the Center of the Bat!
episodes.summary: When Batman is stricken down by a disease, the Atom must miniaturize himself and with Aquaman must travel into the Caped Crusader's body to cure him.

episodes.title: The Eyes of Despero!
episodes.summary: Batman teams up with G'nort, Guy Gardner and Sinestro to battle Despero, a three-eyed alien conqueror who plans to destroy the Green Lantern Corps.

episodes.title: Return of the Fearsome Fangs!
episodes.summary: When three of his former classmates kill their former martial arts teacher, Batman enlists the help of fellow student Bronze Tiger to stop them from stealing the powerful Wudang Totem that the elderly sensei was guarding.

episodes.title: Deep Cover for Batman!
episodes.summary: The Red Hood, a hero from an alternate dimension, enlists the Dark Knight's help against the Injustice Syndicate, a team of supervillains who are doppelgangers of Batman's friends back home.

episodes.title: Game Over for Owlman!
episodes.summary: While Batman battles the Crime Syndicate on an alternate Earth, his counterpart Owlman assembles a host of villains to run rampant across Batman's world.

episodes.title: Mystery in Space!
episodes.summary: Batman comes to the aid of the Question, who has been captured by the balance-obsessed Equinox. Then Batman travels to the planet Ranagar to help Adam Strange repel alien invaders. Along the way Batman picks up a strangely depressed Aquaman who lacks his typical exuberance.

episodes.title: Trials of the Demon!
episodes.summary: Magically transported to 19th century London, Batman aids Etrigan the Demon and Sherlock Holmes in battling Gentleman Jim Craddock, the future Gentleman Ghost.

episodes.title: Night of the Huntress!
episodes.summary: Blue Beetle develops a crush on the slightly older and far-more-dangerous femme fatale Huntress, but there is little time for love with Baby Face busting his gang out of prison for a major heist!

episodes.title: Menace of the Conqueror Caveman!
episodes.summary: 31st Century Booster Gold travels back 100 centuries to join Batman and become a celebrity hero. In his quest for fame, he unwittingly enables the immortal tyrant Vandal Savage to carry out his nefarious plot of turning everyone into cavemen and taking over the world!

episodes.title: The Color of Revenge!
episodes.summary: Batman and Robin team up again, but it's not like it always was -- there was a reason Robin left to go work on his own. As Crazy Quilt comes after Robin for revenge, all the dirty laundry comes out between the dynamic duo!

episodes.title: Legends of the Dark Mite!
episodes.summary: Batman's biggest fan, BatMite, is also his biggest nightmare when the 5th dimensional imp pops up and in an effort to make Batman a better hero, throws Gotham City into chaos. Kidnapping the Dark Knight and traveling to the surreal 5th dimension, the adventure continues with references to many of the classic villains.

episodes.title: Hail the Tornado Tyrant!
episodes.summary: Red Tornado decides to create a "son," but a villain's attack transform his newborn into a villain calling itself the Tornado Tyrant! But before assisting the android hero, Batman must first team up with Green Arrow to battle the Joker and Catwoman.

episodes.title: Duel of the Double Crossers!
episodes.summary: When Mongul recruits Jonah Hex to bring new gladiators to War World, the Old West bounty hunter wrangles the Dark Knight. After a change of heart, Hex and Batman team up to take down the violent empire.

episodes.title: The Last Bat on Earth!
episodes.summary: Batman pursues Gorilla Grodd into the future, where he enlists Kamandi's help against Grodd and his ape army.

episodes.title: When OMAC Attacks!
episodes.summary: The all-American fighting machine OMAC is pitted against the equally destructive Shrapnel in a chaotic fight to the finish, but the architect behind the battle is the mysterious, balance-obsessed villain Libra.

episodes.title: Mayhem of the Music Meister!
episodes.summary: The Music Meister uses his ability to control minds in an effort to take over the world.

episodes.title: Inside the Outsiders!
episodes.summary: Batman and Green Arrow team up to retrieve a pair of statues stolen by Catwoman. Later, Batman tries to free the Outsiders from one of Psycho Pirate's machines.

episodes.title: The Fate of Equinox!
episodes.summary: After a battle with Two-Face, Batman and Dr. Fate must deal with Equinox who is attempting to replace both the Lords of Order and the Lords of Chaos.

episodes.title: Death Race to Oblivion!
episodes.summary: Batman and Captain Marvel deal with Blockbuster. Later, Mogul forces Batman to races both heroes and villains with the fate of the world at stake.

episodes.title: Long Arm of the Law!
episodes.summary: Batman and Plastic Man team up to save some scouts. Later, the two have must deal with Rubberneck and Kite Man who are targeting Plastic Man's family in a scheme for revenge.

episodes.title: Revenge of the Reach!
episodes.summary: The Challengers of the Unknown go to the island and are exposed to Starro. Later, Blue Beetle runs into trouble on Oa when the Green Lantern Corp try to arrest him for possessing the scarab.

episodes.title: Aquaman's Outrageous Adventure!
episodes.summary: Batman and Enemy Ace stop aliens interfering in the past. Later, Aquaman takes his family on vacation and must resist his desire to fight crime.

episodes.title: The Golden Age of Justice!
episodes.summary: Batman and Detective Chimp work together to foil Falseface. Later, Batman and the Justice Society of America face off with Per Degaton.

episodes.title: Sidekicks Assemble!
episodes.summary: Aqualad, Speedy, and Robin decide to team up for their own adventure, and battle Batman's archnemesis Ra's Al Ghul.

episodes.title: Clash of the Metal Men!
episodes.summary: Aquaman falls to Starro. Meanwhile, Batman teams up with the Metal Men to defeat Chemo and, then, to save Doc Magnus from a team of powerful living gases.

episodes.title: A Bat Divided!
episodes.summary: The Riddler torments Booster Gold and Batman. Later, Batman bears witness to the creation of Firestorm. Unfortunately, in the explosion, Batman is divided into three different aspects of himself.

episodes.title: The Super-Batman of Planet X!
episodes.summary: Batman and the Metal Men fight Kanjar Ro. Later, Batman goes to the planet Zur-En-Arrh where he meets another Batman and develops superpowers.

episodes.title: The Power of Shazam!
episodes.summary: Captain Marvel's arch-enemies Black Adam and Dr. Sivana unite to strip the World's Mightiest Mortal of his powers, and Batman must aid the hero before it's too late.

episodes.title: Chill of the Night!
episodes.summary: Phantom Stranger and Spectre make a cosmic wager on whether Batman will choose to kill his parents' murderer or not... and send him back in time to meet his parents before they die.

episodes.title: Gorillas in Our Midst!
episodes.summary: atman and Spectre deal with Dr. Milo. Later, Batman and Detective Chimp enlist Vixen and B'wana Beast in order to battle a conspiracy of ape villains: Gorilla Grodd, Gorilla Boss, and Monsieur Mallah.

episodes.title: The Siege of Starro! (1)
episodes.summary: Led by Faceless Hunter, the Starro Invasion comes on full swing. Only Batman and a handful of unlikely heroes remain uninfected to thwart the alien parasites and their mind-controlled hosts before all of Earth is sucked dry.

episodes.title: The Siege of Starro! (2)
episodes.summary: Star Conqueror may be defeated, but Faceless Hunter is not! The alien warrior manipulates B'Wana Beast, forcing him to combine thetiny starros into one massive beast he plans to use to destroy the planet! But Batman has his own back-up - the Metal Men!

episodes.title: Requiem for a Scarlet Speedster!
episodes.summary: Barry Allen has long been presumed dead and his "ghost" has been haunting Jay Garrick and Kid Flash. When Batman sees it to, they realize he's not dead -- he's been kidnapped by Reverse Flash!

episodes.title: The Last Patrol!
episodes.summary: The disunited super hero group "The Doom Patrol" must now unite once again to face their former enemies who have suddenly united against them.

episodes.title: Menace of the Madniks!
episodes.summary: Booster Gold misses his late best bud, Blue Beetle, but when he travels back in time to hang with him, he throws the present into chaos.

episodes.title: Emperor Joker!
episodes.summary: Fifth-dimensional fan boy Bat-Mite inadvertently gives Joker his limitless power while hoping to witness a hero-villain showdown.

episodes.title: The Criss Cross Conspiracy!
episodes.summary: The long-retired Batwoman sees an opportunity for revenge against the villain who humiliated her: The Riddler. In order to get back at him, she hires the sorcerer Felix Faust to swap her body with Batman's.

episodes.title: The Plague of the Prototypes!
episodes.summary: Batman sends a new squad of bat-robots against Black Mask. The robots are turned against their former master when Black Mask hacks into them. Batman prepares to fight the robots with his dog partner, Ace. They are also joined with the kindly robot prototype "Proto".

episodes.title: Cry Freedom Fighters!
episodes.summary: When an alien race tries to invade Earth, Batman, Plastic Man and the Freedom Fighters race to their planet to stop them. Thealien's numbers prove overwhelming and it falls on Plastic Man to find the patriotism within to stop them.

episodes.title: The Knights of Tomorrow!
episodes.summary: It is the story of Batman's retirement and his marriage to Catwoman. Bruce Wayne now hopes that his son Damian will follow in his footsteps, and his confidence in him will be put to the test.

episodes.title: Darkseid Descending!
episodes.summary: The threat of an impending invasion from Apokolips compels Batman, Aquaman, and Martian Manhunter to form a new Justice League.

episodes.title: Battle of the Superheroes!
episodes.summary: When Superman is affected by Red Kryptonite he becomes a super jerk. Batman must stop him from destroying his reputation and more.

episodes.title: Bat-Mite Presents: Batman's Strangest Cases!
episodes.summary: Bat-Mite hosts a series of Batman's most bizarre adventures including the Mad Magazine-inspired Batboy and Rubin, a Japanese-influenced Bat-Manga and a guest starring role from the Scooby Gang and Weird Al Yankovic.

episodes.title: The Malicious Mr. Mind!
episodes.summary: Batman joins forces with Captain Marvel, Mary Marvel, and Captain Marvel Jr. to take on Dr. Sivana and his Monster Society of Evil. However, the villains gain the most likely of newcomers -- the wormlike Mr. Mind.

episodes.title: Joker: The Vile and Villainous!
episodes.summary: The Joker teams up with his criminal hero and inspiration, The Weeper, to take down their arch-nemesis Batman in this Jokerized episode where the roles are reversed.

episodes.title: Shadow of the Bat!
episodes.summary: Bat-Ape rescues Batman and Robin from Catwoman. Later, Batman is bitten by a vampire and turns on his friends in the Justice League International.

episodes.title: Night of the Batmen!
episodes.summary: Batman and Vigilante have a run in with some villains. Later Aquaman, Captain Marvel, Plastic Man, and Green Arrow try to fill in when Batmen is injured.

episodes.title: Scorn of the Star Sapphire!
episodes.summary: Hal Jordan, the Green Lantern, comes to Batman for help in defeating his nemesis, the beautiful supervillain Star Sapphire.

episodes.title: Time Out for Vengeance!
episodes.summary: The Creeper cheers on and helps Batman when he's fighting Hellgrammite. Then, the Justice League International travels to the past to stop the minions of Equinox from wiping out all the incarnations of Batman throughout time.

episodes.title: Sword of the Atom!
episodes.summary: Searching the Amazon jungle for the missing Ray Palmer, the scientist who was at one time The Atom, Batman disappears. Now Aquaman recruits the new Atom, Ryan Choi, to help shrink him down to microscopic size.

episodes.title: Triumvirate of Terror!
episodes.summary: After the world's greatest baseball game against the Legion of Doom, Batman, Superman and Wonder Woman face off against their arch-enemies Joker, Lex Luthor and Cheetah, who gain the upper hand by switching their respective opponents.

episodes.title: Bold Beginnings!
episodes.summary: After a team up with Space Ghost and his companions, Batman must come to the aid of three of his fellow superheroes who have fallen into the icy clutches of Mr. Freeze.

episodes.title: Powerless!
episodes.summary: Captain Atom joins the Justice League, but has to learn how to continue being a super hero even after losing his powers to his old enemy Major Force.

episodes.title: Crisis: 22,300 Miles Above Earth!
episodes.summary: While the Justice Society is visiting the Justice League for the first time, Batman is in Asia infiltrating a secret fortress where Ra's Al Ghul is plotting a new scheme for world domination.

episodes.title: Four Star Spectacular!
episodes.summary: Batman teams up with DC characters Adam Strange, the Flash, 'Mazing Man and the Creature Commandos in four separate teaser vignettes.

episodes.title: Mitefall!
episodes.summary: In the year 1865, in parallel universe 5501, Batman helps foil an assassination attempt on the life of Abraham Lincoln by a steampunk armored John Wilkes Booth. Bat-Mite has grown weary of Batman: The Brave and the Bold, deeming its formula to be tired and repetitive, so he concocts a scheme to make it so bad that the network will have to cancel the show to make way for a darker one. Can Ambush Bug thwart his plan before it's too late?

episodes.title: The Mask of Matches Malone!
episodes.summary: After a team-up with Black Orchid, Batman goes after Catwoman as she tries to steal the Cloak of Neferteri. However, Black Canary and Huntress arrive, on the trail of Two-face. Catwoman aids the heroes, but when Batman gets amnesia, he believes he's his undercover identity of Matches Malone... and goes on a criminal rampage.
